cover_headline: India Caps Margins on 137 Cancer Drugs, Prices to Fall Up to 70% From November 9
facts: The NPPA capped trade margins at 30% of MRP on 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines
Mark-ups averaged about 170% and reached 700% in some cases before the cap
Manufacturers must file revised prices within 7 days of the October 17 Gazette notification

end.headline: India Caps Margins on 137 Cancer Drugs, Prices to Fall Up to 70% From November 9
end.line: Covered drugs include Pembrolizumab and Osimertinib, used across more than 20 cancer types.
